AwardsPage.title: Awards
AwardsPage.description: The group's wins and nominations, grouped by ceremony year.
AwardsPage.yearNote: The year is the ceremony's, not the work's: an autumn release is usually honoured at the following year's ceremony.
AwardsPage.nominationsNote: The list of wins is complete according to the source. The list of nominations is not: the original table holds many more than appear here, so a missing nomination does not mean it never happened.
AwardsPage.glossaryTitle: Two words that show up in the names
AwardsPage.bonsang: A bonsang (본상) is a main prize at a Korean ceremony. There is not just one: each edition hands several to the year's most notable artists, so winning one does not mean finishing first.
AwardsPage.daesang: A daesang (대상) is the ceremony's grand prize. One is given per category, and it ranks above the bonsang.
AwardsPage.pendingNotice: The full awards record is pending verification, so this page appears empty: the site only publishes what has been checked.

GroupPage.title: The group
GroupPage.description: Formation, career and records of BLACKPINK.
GroupPage.formationBody: BLACKPINK debuted on 8 August 2016 under YG Entertainment with the single album SQUARE ONE, released with two title tracks at once. The group has four members: Jisoo, Jennie, Rose and Lisa.
GroupPage.conceptBody: The name puts together the two colours that define their aesthetic: black and pink. It is the tension between the two, not either one alone, that has held the visual identity of the group together since the debut.
GroupPage.recordsBody: They were the first K-pop girl group to perform at Coachella (2019) and the first K-pop act to headline it (2023). The specific figures, with their sources, are in the fun facts section.

Chat.title: Chat with PINKY
Chat.subtitle: The site's virtual guide
Chat.welcome: Hi! I'm PINKY. I can tell you about BLACKPINK and take you to the part of the site you're looking for.
Chat.proactive: Hi! I'm PINKY. Looking for something specific? Ask me and I'll take you there.
Chat.disclaimer: Virtual assistant. Not a real person.
Chat.transcribeReview: Check the text before sending it.
Chat.micDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Enable it from the icon in your browser's address bar and try again. In the meantime, you can type.
Chat.micUnsupported: Your browser can't record audio. You can type your question instead.
Chat.micError: Couldn't reach the microphone. Check that no other app is using it.
Chat.audioPrivacy: Audio is sent for transcription and is not stored.
Chat.errEmptyAudio: No speech was recognised. Try moving closer to the microphone.
Chat.errUnsupportedFormat: That audio format isn't supported. Try webm, mp3, wav, m4a or ogg.
Chat.errTooLarge: The file is too large. The limit is 10 MB.
Chat.errTooLong: The audio is too long. The limit is one minute.
Chat.errQuota: The transcription quota has run out. Please try again in a little while.
Chat.errRateLimit: You've sent too many recordings in a row. Wait a few minutes.
Chat.errUnavailable: Transcription isn't available right now. You can type your question.
Chat.voiceUnsupported: Your browser can't read the answers out loud.

CreditsPage.title: Image credits
CreditsPage.lead: The member photographs come from Wikimedia Commons and are published here under a Creative Commons licence. Crediting the author is a condition of that licence, not a courtesy.
CreditsPage.licenceBody: All four photographs are under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (CC BY 3.0). That licence requires one thing: name the author, link the licence, link the source and state whether the work has been modified. It does not include the ShareAlike clause, so it does not require the rest of this site to carry the same licence, and it permits both commercial use and adaptation.
CreditsPage.changesBody: The files served by this site are resized to 960 pixels wide and cropped on screen to fit a 3:4 frame. No image content has been altered. The licence requires changes to be stated, and this is that statement.
CreditsPage.author: Author
CreditsPage.empty: There are no licensed images to credit yet.
CreditsPage.otherBody: Frames without a photograph are this site's own placeholder. No audio or video file is hosted or served here: the music plays in Spotify's official player.
CreditsPage.galleryBody: The sixty gallery images also come from Wikimedia Commons. They have been resized to a maximum width of 1400 pixels and converted to JPEG; none has been cropped or otherwise altered. Stating the change in size is a licence obligation, and this is that statement.
CreditsPage.galleryShareAlike: Nine of the sixty are under CC BY-SA, which adds the ShareAlike clause: a DERIVATIVE of those images would have to be published under the same licence. Resizing does not create a derivative, which is why this site only resizes and never crops. Each photograph shows its own licence beside it.
